> Member Benefits

#### •   What member benefits am I entitled to as a member of Chartered Accountants Ireland?

Information on the benefits of Chartered Accountants Ireland membership can be found here.

CPA Ireland members will automatically be signed up to Chartered Accountants Ireland Member Benefits newsletter. Members can avail of Career Support and Wellbeing Support. More details can be found here:

- Career Support
- Thrive Wellbeing Hub
